title: Frequency-irregular interaural mismatch did not improve cross-cycle prediction of dizziness, balance or falling complaints
abstract: In independently recruited NHANES 1999–2000 to 2001–2002 complete-case cohorts (n=921/1032), adding frequency-irregular interaural mismatch changed weighted log loss for past-year dizziness/balance/falling complaints from 0.487112 to 0.489636, delta +0.002523 (joint PSU-bootstrap 95% [-0.002160,+0.020925]). The registered predictive-improvement criterion failed.
